verdict.rationale: Docs describe a dedicated plugin-creator skill that scaffolds the required plugin.json manifest, wires MCP servers, and generates a local marketplace entry for testing, plus a separate skill-creation flow that interviews the user on skill behavior/triggers/scripts and a recorder that drafts a skill from a demonstrated workflow, together covering writing, improving, and packaging skills. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that the plugin-creator meta-skill works end-to-end, and clearer documentation of iterative improving of an existing skill rather than just initial scaffolding.
